newsitem.title: JAPAN: TYK Corp margin trade restrictions to be eased-TSE.
newsitem.headline: TYK Corp margin trade restrictions to be eased-TSE.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Tuesday it would ease margin trading restrictions on TYK Corp shares starting with orders placed on March 13.
Exchange officials said that under the previous restrictions, TYK margin downpayments were set at 60 percent or more of the total trade amount.
The lower limit will be lowered to 30 percent, which is in line with most shares traded through margin accounts.
The bourse will continue to disclose the outstanding volume of margin trades on a daily basis. Outstanding volumes of volatile shares are sometimes announced as a precautionary measure for investors.
In Tuesday's session, shares in TYK, Japan's largest manufacturer of firebricks, fell three yen to end at 585.
